targets.empty: No targets yet. Add one, then verify ownership before scanning.

scans.activeNote: Active modules require a target with active-testing authorization.
scans.aiPlannerHint: Requires an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; leave off to scan without AI.
scans.addVerifyFirst: Add and verify a target first.
scans.pipelineStopped: The pipeline stopped here — later stages did not run and no report was generated.
scans.sNotApplicable: Not applicable to this target type
scans.fixDns: The target hostname could not be resolved. Check the domain/host is spelled correctly and is publicly resolvable (has DNS records).
scans.fixTimeout: The tool timed out. The target may be slow, rate-limiting, or filtering traffic — retry, or narrow the scope.
scans.fixRefused: The target refused the connection or is unreachable from the scanner. Confirm it is online and reachable.
scans.fixGeneric: Review the tool error above and the target configuration, then re-run the scan.
